sources.title: Security rollout note
sources.text: Security approval is the main risk. The customer needs a data retention answer before the budget window closes.

sources.title: Training plan
sources.text: Training should cover agent handoff, translation quality review, and support escalation.

sources.title: Pricing latency note
sources.text: Pricing depends on the pilot seat count. Latency and translation quality are the key acceptance criteria.

sources.title: Unrelated onboarding
sources.text: The onboarding calendar includes training owners and regional enablement sessions.
